stem.text: An engine transforms thermal energy into mechanical work. The engine takes in thermal energy $Q_\text{in}$ from a heat source and gives out thermal energy $Q_\text{out}$ to a heat sink, producing useful work $W$.

stem.alt: Flow diagram with heat source at the top and heat sink at the bottom, a box labelled engine in the middle, a downward arrow labelled Qin, a downward arrow labelled Qout and a rightward arrow labelled W.

stem.text: What is the efficiency of this engine?
